ctx.x: Consolidated Radio Artists. Charlie Green. He's the one that handled us, you know, he booked it. So he said, "Well, Jonah --," because Stuff, he never talked no sense. Nobody never knew what to talk with him, you know. So they'd always tell me. So he said, "Well, Jonah, you know you guys wouldn't listen to what you were told. You wanted to do everything you wanted to do. I don't know what you're going to do about it now. You'll have to go up to the National."

We went up to 802, and they said, "No, we don't want to be bothered. We don't have anything to do with you all. We don't have anything to do with what you guys do." Then Rosenberg (Cherman) was the President. He was over on 6th then. And so now they said, "You guys have to go to the National."
So we went up there where Weber was, you know, and later become the guy from Chicago --
